rules.title: GET /campaigns/lists always 500 (AttributeError ProspectList.prospect_count)
rules.note: Suspected location: app/routers/campaign_wizard_router.py:233 get_available_lists reads ProspectList.prospect_count which the model does not have. The campaign wizard list picker is broken for every role.

rules.title: POST /campaigns/wizard-creations (and wizard-executions) always 500: CampaignStateEvent(event_id=...) TypeError
rules.note: Suspected location: app/services/campaign_wizard_service.py:402 _log_campaign_event passes an invalid keyword 'event_id' to CampaignStateEvent (called from step_1_create_campaign, line 154). Wizard campaign creation and one-shot wizard execution are unusable.

rules.title: POST /campaigns/wizard-creations (and wizard-executions) always 500: CampaignStateEvent(event_id=...) TypeError
POST /campaigns/{id}/activations on an already ACTIVE campaign -> uncaught ValueError -> 500
rules.note: Suspected location: app/services/campaign_email_service.py:373 launch() raises ValueError('Cannot launch campaign with status: ACTIVE'); router app/routers/campaign_wizard_router.py:554 (activate_campaign) does not translate it to 409/400.

rules.title: POST /campaigns/{id}/generations 500: FK violation when regenerating templates that have versions/attachments
rules.note: Suspected location: app/services/batch_processor_service.py:376 generate_templates_per_persona deletes existing EmailTemplate rows that are still referenced by email_template_versions / email_attachments (IntegrityError 1451). Reached from campaign_wizard_router.py:306 process_list_auto.

rules.title: Unreachable external dependency reported as bare HTTP 500 (POST /inboxes/{id}/sync)
rules.note: app/routers/inbox_router.py sync_inbox_history raises HTTPException(500) when IMAP is unreachable; should be 502/504.

rules.title: LLM unavailable -> 500 with leaked internals ('NoneType' object has no attribute 'chat')
rules.note: POST /templates/{id}/regenerations: error should be 502/503 with a clean message. Environment trigger (no OpenAI key) but the failure is an unhandled None client.

rules.title: Strings longer than the DB column -> 500 'Data too long' (no max_length validation) on many create/update endpoints
rules.note: Affects company-profiles, campaign-drafts, automation-rules, wizard, products, stages, template-library, reports/custom, inboxes, prospects, conversations reply, auth/register, uploads confirmations, campaigns/templates regenerate, revalidate. Pydantic models need max_length / handlers need to map DataError 1406 to 422.

rules.title: Free text sent to short/enum-like columns (sending_mode, unsubscribe_mode, provider, status, warmup_status, unit, object_type) -> 500
rules.note: Values are not validated against the allowed set; the DB rejects them (data too long / enum) and the request ends in 500 instead of 422.

rules.title: Out-of-range integers (-1 / 10^15) -> 500 (DB out of range / negative hour)
rules.note: campaign-drafts current_step, campaigns min_gap_minutes/batch_size, wizard hours/cool_off_days, contacts/fields sort_order, opportunity activities duration_minutes. Add ge/le bounds.

rules.title: POST /campaigns/wizard-creations 500 on malformed/unknown inbox ids
rules.note: Same root cause as wizard-creations 500.

rules.title: POST /campaigns/wizard-creations 500 on malformed/unknown inbox ids
Negative / huge integer query parameters -> 500 (limit, fy)
rules.note: deliverability_router.py:307 (list_external_events/metrics) passes negative limit into SQL LIMIT -> MySQL syntax error; sales_reports_router.py:346 -> services/sales.py:119 fiscal_year_bounds ValueError/OverflowError for fy=-1 or 10^30. Add ge/le bounds.

rules.title: reports/export/campaign-comparison 500 on special-character user_id
rules.note: reports_router.py:243 export_campaign_comparison_csv puts the user-supplied user_id into a header/filename -> UnicodeEncodeError (latin-1) -> 500.

rules.title: POST /uploads/validations: 2.4 MB / 600k-row CSV is processed synchronously >40 s (no row/size cap)
rules.note: Client timed out after 40 s; availability/DoS risk.

rules.title: Cross-tenant reference accepted: POST /templates with another tenant's sequence_id -> 201
rules.note: POST /templates (app/routers/template_router.py) does not check that sequence_id belongs to the caller's campaign/tenant; the template is created pointing at tenant B's sequence.

rules.title: POST /campaigns/wizard-creations 500 on malformed/unknown inbox ids
rules.note: Cross-tenant inbox id causes the same 500 (cannot assess isolation until the wizard bug is fixed).

rules.title: Upload id is not server state (stateless revalidation)
rules.note: /uploads/{id}/revalidations works on the records in the body; the id is not looked up, so there is nothing to isolate.

rules.title: Unknown id answered 200 where the endpoint is stateless/reference data
rules.note: persona-blueprints (falls back), uploads revalidations.

rules.title: GET /reports/export/global-analytics/docx 500 when stored data contains control characters (NUL bytes accepted on input)
rules.note: Server: app/services/reports_service.py:1182 _add_data_table -> python-docx ValueError 'All strings must be XML compatible'. Control characters (\u0000) sent by the special-string probes are accepted and stored by some endpoints, then break the export for the whole tenant. Fix: reject/strip control chars on input and sanitise on export.
